description: This file defines the ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions class, which contains configuration settings for resource-based placement of grains in an Orleans cluster. It includes properties for weights related to CPU, memory, available memory, activation count, and silo preference margin, along with default values and validation logic.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptions
classes.description: A sealed class that encapsulates configuration options for resource-optimized placement of grains in an Orleans cluster.

classes.name: ResourceOptimizedPlacementOptionsValidator
classes.description: An internal sealed class responsible for validating the configuration options, ensuring all weight properties are within the valid range [0-100].

methods.name: ValidateConfiguration
methods.description: Validates the configuration properties to ensure they are within the acceptable range [0-100], throwing an exception if any property is out of bounds.
